授業概要
This course is intended to give students a grounding in basic Japanese history, including diplomatic, economic, literary, military, and religious issues. It will introduce the students to the major sources of academic information on these issues. Rather than burden the students with historical details, the course is intended to teach broad trends that impact today’s society. The class is held in English. Each week, students will read from an assigned text, and discuss the text online before class and in class. There will be a wide variety of texts, including historical documents and works of literature.
